## Analog Devices growth projections rise ahead of earnings but valuation flagged as stretched

A stretched-valuation flag ahead of ADI's August 19 earnings (Street at $2.93 EPS per separate coverage) raises the bar for a post-earnings re-rating; an in-line print may be insufficient to catalyze upside if the multiple is already full.

- Pre-earnings coverage notes rising ADI growth projections heading into the Q3 report.
- Valuation characterized as potentially too high relative to those growth expectations.
- No specific growth rate, EPS estimate, or price target cited in this coverage.
- The tension between improving fundamentals and a demanding multiple is the central editorial theme.
